_note: FE-owned registry (contract section 2). Proposed as an ADDITIVE replacement of contract/ids/spots.json: every id in contract-v1.0.0-rc1 is kept unchanged; new ids are appended. Never renamed. Spot ids are global (venueId.spotId), as the rc1 venue room expects for `sit`. Each spot carries its venue-local position (x, z metres; rotY radians; x right, z forward) and, if claimable with `sit`, the clip the server should set (`anim`: act_sit / act_type); FE walkable rectangles match the venue scenes. Kinds kept from rc1 where the id existed. fe.2 (venue builder, 2026-10-08): additive spots for the venue dioramas; new sets checker_kiosk, yacht_club, penthouse_row.
units: metres, radians; venue-local; x right, z forward
